Library

Learning resources

Courses, videos, docs and tutorials from other publishers. Each link was checked on the date shown.

Back to the library

How to use this hub: pick a skill, then narrow by cost and format. Start with the shortest item that suits your level, and keep a note of what you would change in your own work. Items marked "free tier" or "paid" say so, and a duration appears only when the publisher states it. Summaries explain why each resource matters to someone who directs AI agents rather than writes every line of code.

  • Adobe

    Creating Product Images at Scale with Firefly Services (opens the publisher's site in a new tab)

    • Free
    • Tutorial
    • Advanced

    Adobe describes a Python workflow that combines product images, prompts, sizes, and translations using Firefly Services and Dropbox. Map its inputs, outputs, and human review steps with any assistant, then check a small fictional campaign for missing or misleading translations. Running the example needs provider credentials and may incur service costs; inspect permissions and protect secrets.

    Skills: Creative media, Business automation, AI agents. Link checked 7 November 2026.

  • Adobe

    Firefly Generate Image API Tutorial (opens the publisher's site in a new tab)

    • Free
    • Tutorial
    • Intermediate

    Adobe explains how to generate and localize images using its Firefly API and a Node.js example. Ask your preferred assistant to draft a fictional campaign brief, then review the generated image for suitability, accessibility, and usage rights. The guide is free to read; API credentials and service charges or access restrictions may apply, and secrets must stay out of prompts and public code.

    Skills: Creative media, Brand and web design, AI agents. Link checked 7 November 2026.
